FN-DG2YGTH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 226
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Crawford
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/18/2025
House Bill 226 as introduced could decrease potential ad valorem tax receipts to the Public
School Fund, State General Fund, Veterans' Assistance Fund, the Alabama Historical
Commission, and to county and municipal governments by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the property value of residences of individuals who could claim a homestead exemption
pursuant to this bill but who otherwise are not independently eligible to claim a homestead
exemption under current law, but enjoy such exemption through their spouse.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue
in order to adopt rules to implement this act.
Page 1
